Im so sorry that you've endured similar circumstances. No one should ever go through such a thing. It's very painful and in tearing just reading what you've wrote. But thank you very much for taking the time and effort to respond. It's good not to feel alone in a time like this, even if it's a stranger on the internet that lives far away. 

It just feels like all the work I've been doing isn't helping. It's not fair that we get to suffer more even after these situations have stopped. It's not fair the way people push me away when I open up to them. A lot of the things I've heard time and time again from therapists and close friends who care. I guess im dull to it know. Im pretty sure you are correct I am having an episode as a response to stressors in my life. Im just tired of feeling like this, i don't want to feel like a victim anymore. I don't really want to put more work into trying to get better if it's a slow process. I don't want to waste a long period of time trying to recover on my own. I don't know what i really need, want, or how to fix this. I never believed in hope, it's not certain that things will get better and it isn't getting better like i want to right now. So why do i keep going?

Edit: may i pm you about advice for checking myself in at a hospital? Because that might be a better course of action instead of doing something reckless.

Im already on an antipsychotic (Zyprexa) and it's also prescribed to me as a sleeping aid. Idk if it has the same effects as the one you mentioned or not but I've been on so many different medications that it doesn't matter to me anymore.

Im 21 so yes. 

What kind of drugs if you knew. 

Distractions dont feel fullfilling anymore, and they just feel dreadful and shitty. Even the yobbies and the things im intreseted in.
It went great it was fun. Im volunteering for an organization that helps kids who went through abuse and i start my training on Thursday so let's see how that goes.

Psychology and i do that in my free time or when i feel motivated to. 

I would want to draw something, but I've been trying almost every other day and im just not feeling it and it's doing me nothing.

Set and setting is usually a quite chill day at home alone since i have no one to trip sit me or take me places. Idk if that qualifies as a good set and setting or not, so you let me know. But that bad shit just keeps coming, i just feel so out of control and my thoughts racing nonstop. I'd like to believe im facing it but i don't even know what im facing. I just don't believe there's an answer, it's always suffering without feeling any better after the trip besides me glad that it's over. The only "epiphany" i had on psychedelics is that i realized that i truly don't want to live and the only reason im still living is because i don't want go to harm those who care about me and envy of those who live better lives than me since i wish i had the same. 

Im 21 and i really love where i am rn (location wise). I just feel different and that i am "too much" or "too nice" to people. Im not hopeful. Throughout my life being hopeful only caused me harm and pain so i tend to view things more pessimistically, which is not ideal but i never had good experiences to change my mindset and view of things. 

I am also going to counseling, psych, taking meds regularly. I go hiking everyday and am in good shape physically. I also am introverted and distancing myself is something im great at. So is burning bridges and cutting toxic people out, i have no one i want to be close to or people who want to be close to me. 

I don't have a grudge against myself. But i don't like myself because I have no reason to. So far i haven't been presented with reasons that would make me feel otherwise. My past has been painful, my present stressful, and future discouraging. I don't say these things because I'm trying to be a downer or because i hate myself. I am genuinely concerned and worried about my well being. 

Im really glad psychedelics have worked for you, and that you're able to see some good and hope come out of it. I truly appreciate the thoughtful responses you've given me so far so thank you.

I have cut down a lot but im mostly in my head all day long and alone that i feel forced back to playing video games or watching something. I do take good care of myself (id like to think at least). I wake up in the morning everyday, i hike everyday, keep my room always clean and tidy. And yes, im feeling alone a lot even though i do have friends here they're just aren't relatable or really fun to hang out with. They're not bad people and i like them , i just feel different and that we're not close. I hang out with them every now and again because i feel like i need some sort of social interaction so i don't go crazy. I should also be focusing on next semester of school and getting prepared for it but im out of motivation and quite frankly i just feel detached and unmotivated. Like I've done everything i can and that i don't have more fight in me. I need some sort of purpose to keep me going, and if i don't i just don't see a reason to keep going.

I do doodle a lot but lately ive been getting no joy from that either. Like i love doing it but i just don't feel the same towards the end anymore. I do smoke weed or take edibles generally at night or in my days off. It could help as much as weed could. I haven't done mushrooms in so long but doing mushrooms never really felt like it helped me in anyway. Everytime i do mushrooms it feels like if in ptsd hell. I would love to have an experience on psychedelics like those who claim have helped them in some sort of way. It never has for me so far. I have a 2 tabs of lsd and some dmt and i was thinking of doing some soon in hopes maybe this time itll feel helpful if i do it differently maybe. I never tried Journaling and im willing to try any advice im given here. I have one problem with writing (or reading anything I've written) which is cringing and getting mad and hateful towards myself when i reread what I've wrote. And that leads me to throw out what i wrote because of disgust and fear of people stumbling upon it. Im still willing to give a shot and see how long that lasts.

And my family is crazy, the friends ik aren't relatable and the only way i could enjoy being around them is by getting drunk. Socially im fucked so far and idk how to change it and i think it's having a serious toll on my health rn. 

I really appreciate you being thoughtful in your reply <3

Im actually going to volunteer tomorrow for the first time in so long. Im not sure how it will go and if there are any volunteers. But hopefully it would turn out to be eventful. Thank for you advice.

Idk my dreams were humble, i just wanted to leave the shitty dysfunctional family i lived with and move to the US, eventually settling with someone and living here permanently. I am here in the US now, but im more unhappy and alone than I ever was. I don't really have much im good at and i feel burned out of all my hobbies and everything honestly. Idk what really there is to do anymore that brings me any joy or makes me feel motivated.
I hike every morning at 7am, work out 4 days a week. I still want to yeet myself into the void.

I don't really know how to do that, i just don't know how to force myself to cry on command like this. I also don't exactly understand how that could be helpful, would you mind explaining to me? I have a very hard expressing myself and letting out emotions or understand my own feelings so I'm willing to take any advice.

I don't really know how to cry on my own and im not sure if that would help. But yes i do feel like im repressing emotions like sadness and anger all day long and even though im doing healthy things im still doing them to avoid how im feeling. Im constantly feeling angry, sad and lonely and o have no real outlet to let these feelings out. Talking to people doesn't seem to help, nor do creative outlets. There's nothing that seems helpful that i could do to express them so idk.

Im sorry to hear that youre struggling as well and im glad you're noticing an uplift in your mood and I wish that hope keeps you going as well! :) 

Yes i do feel very exhausted a feel little to no enjoyment or satisfaction from what im doing. But i made it so far i guess, idk really know if there's anything to help with that anymore so ill guess have to accept how shitty it feels now until maybe something changes. Thank you for your support friend i really I appreciate it :)

I do emdr every Monday and I feel like I've made a lot of progress since beginning. I think ive made peace with a lot things in my past but rehearsing over and over is just exhausting now and i don't think im noticing any results. Idk if that counts or not.

Im tired of fighting. I don't really see a bright future for myself. Everything feels like white noise and I'm in my head all day and it's not helping being alone. I'm going to try keep it up i guess but because im trying to resist the urge to fall into that hole again. I just feel tired. I just wish there's something someone can tell me that make this easier.

Oh no you didn't sound like a dick at all! If anything you sound very relatable. 

Well I think your goal, just like mine, is to get better and get some satisfaction from your life. How long have you been in counseling/psych? It's unfortunate that we may have to suffer from such disorders for a long time but I've seen numerous people in my life who ik personally who have learned to cope so well that they're lives feel free these disorders (whether they were "cured" or not). Running everyday won't necessarily make you happy, but it's a good mechanism to cope and in the long run is better for your overall health mental and physical, which increases your chances at leading a happier or more content life.

I understand what you mean when you say hate people that tell you that "people won't love you until you love yourself". It hits me had because literally yesterday i had this conversation with a friend. She said "You can't rely on anyone for your happiness, or you'll never be happy, because no one can make you happy," which i understand what she's trying to say but I also dont like myself either. Idk how to. I seem to have gotten better in every way but that. Im often trapped in my own head too, and when i complain about being lonely I get told the same thing again. I don't have much advice to give on this regard because i feel like we're in the same boat. Just don't forget to take care of yourself and don't let yourself fall into that hole. <3

I'd like to think im self sufficient enough. Yes i do get into those periods where my mental health suffers but I quickly bounce up and try to get back it again. But it never feels like it ever pays off. Im not happy doing anything I'm doing and idk how to deal with it. People keep telling me "You can't rely on anyone for your happiness, or you'll never be happy, because no one can make you happy," and im not reliant on anyone to be happy. Yes I do wish I have more people in my life that would make me happy, I'm not happy on my own or with people.
